correctness.rationale: In normal form, (r^i s)^2=r^{hi}. If x=F(r)=r^i and y=F(s) is central then (h-2)i=0 modulo m, leaving four pairs. If x is a rotation and y is an outside involution, all m choices of i work for each of the m/2 possible y, and for nonzero i the image has size 2m/gcd(i,m); the order-four case is V4, and the larger proper images are dihedral since h acts trivially on their rotation subgroups. If x=r^i s with i odd, a central y cannot invert x, and an outside involution y=r^{2j}s would require 4j+2(h-1)i=0 modulo m, impossible modulo 4. For i even the involutions commuting with x are 1, r^h, x, xr^h, giving two C2 and two V4 maps per x. This exhausts and yields every coefficient, including n=4. For idempotence, any nontrivial x=c=r^h or any image containing c with F(c)=1 is excluded. A cyclic x with outside y must satisfy i^2=i modulo m, hence i=0 or 1; i=1 forces y=s. Outside x=r^{2j}s not killed by idempotence must have y=x, since with y=1 it maps to 1. The two proper families (1,t) and (t,t) have different kernel intersections with the characteristic rotation subgroup, and conjugation by r↦r, s↦r^{2w}s is transitive inside each. For the comparison families of the same order: dihedral has 2m proper projections onto reflections (two C2 characters per reflection; no other proper retract by the same rotation/idempotence test). In the quaternion presentation y^2=x^h, odd rotation x forces a surjective map, outside x is impossible since y would be central and unable to invert x, and even rotation x gives image within the central C2 which is killed by F; no proper nontrivial retract. For the index limit, the cyclic-x/outside-y block has weight (m^2/2)/(m^2/2+2m+4); its index exponent is the valuation of uniform i modulo m capped at n−1 (assign that cap to i=0). The geometric law 2^{-v-1} on v≥0 differs from this capped law in total variation by 2^{-n}. The discarded weight is O(1/m), proving total-variation convergence. The all-order derivation, not the finite recorded checker output, establishes the result.
residual_risks: Restriction to n≥4 and the specified semidihedral action; no extrapolation to all metacyclic groups.

value.rationale: Image sizes and retracts are natural map invariants of a standard maximal-class family. The sharp absence of nontrivial retracts larger than C2, despite proper dihedral images at every nonabelian intermediate order and plentiful V4 images, is a useful distinction; the two transitive families are organized by different kernel intersections, not just a total count. The full spectrum quantifies how many maps realize each structure and directly supports the limiting index statistic.
residual_risks: The index limit is a short consequence of the classification, not an independent classification theorem or a result for arbitrary 2-groups.
